purpose: Enumerate the minimal future H0 registration delta surface required before a producer can claim native-universe completeness for the frozen runtime consumer universe.

required_bindings.required_value_or_shape: exact consumer identity gctm_runtime_native_candidate_universe_v1 or a later superseding owner-accepted identity
exact frozen event-key version (gctm_runtime_event_key_v1 or successor)
exact stage id pre_score_eligible_v1 or an owner-accepted alternative that remains score-independent
h0_pair_pre_score_mask_v1 or successor with immutable reject-reason partition
per-stream emitted counts for pair/candidate/event sidecars
native candidate and pair key totals
explicit overflow/truncation booleans and counters; silent drop forbidden
bridge_attempt_count, identity_uid_wrap_events, and any exposure predicates required by the consumer
capture must remain decision-neutral and replayable under the declared observer basis
membership fields available after native event formation and before runtime ranking claim; no claim/commit/label dependence
ABI, event-key version, inclusion-stage, mask, uid, and completeness-predicate invalidation inputs

required_guarantee_capabilities: bind envelope/native-universe sidecars, not only pair/candidate/claim/commit field coordinates
fail closed on overflow, partial events, silent truncation, and cross-event candidate splits
explicit_non_claims: This artifact does not modify registration-v2.
This artifact does not create registration-v3.
This artifact does not authorize H0 capture or re-entry.
This artifact does not establish an H0 completeness guarantee.
